trends.name: Iran-Israel War Oil Supply Crisis
trends.summary: Oil prices surging toward 4-year highs as Iran conflict intensifies with no resolution in sight. Kharg Island simultaneously loading 5 tankers; Haifa refinery hit by fire. Hormuz Strait access threatened by both US threats to destroy wells and Iran's conditional openness, creating critical energy supply uncertainty affecting global inflation and central bank policy.

trends.name: Recession Probability Surge to 40%
trends.summary: Prediction markets now price 40% recession odds—sharp climb in recent weeks driven by Iran war impacts, policy uncertainty, and growth concerns. Goldman Sachs signals markets have priced in both hawkish policy shock and modest growth shock, indicating investor repricing of macro risks.

trends.name: Eurozone Economic Deterioration & Sentiment Collapse
trends.summary: Eurozone consumer confidence crashed to -16.3 (from -12.2), economic confidence fell to 96.6, and inflation alarm bells ringing as Iran war threatens European economic stability. EU officials expressing serious concern about war continuation; Spain closing airspace to Iran-related flights complicates logistics and escalates costs.

trends.name: Policy Rate Cuts Expected Post-Oil Shock
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs analysis indicates oil supply shocks historically lead to modestly lower policy rates after 6-9 months, suggesting Fed pivot likely if Iran conflict persists. Markets have already priced in hawkish policy shock alongside growth concerns, positioning for eventual rate cuts.

trends.name: Airline & Transportation Fuel Cost Squeeze
trends.summary: Budget airlines facing painful reality as fuel costs spike; higher prices pinching consumer budgets beyond gas pump. Australia temporarily halving fuel tax as war impacts logistics costs. Fewer flights and new fees spreading across industry as margins compress.

trends.name: Automotive Trade-In Negative Equity Crisis
trends.summary: Nearly 1 in 3 car buyers underwater on trade-ins with 'troubling' dollar amounts, signaling deteriorating consumer balance sheets and potential credit stress. Reflects broader weakness in auto sector financing conditions and consumer purchasing power.

trends.name: S&P 500 Correction Near Bottom
trends.summary: Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson signals S&P 500 correction getting closer to ending. Bill Ackman argues world-beating US stocks now 'extremely cheap' despite war volatility. Tech valuations attracting investors despite macro uncertainty.

trends.name: China's PPI Deflation Ending; Commodity Demand Rising
trends.summary: China's 41-month PPI deflation cycle could end by March—6-9 months earlier than expected—driven by surging global energy prices from Iran conflict. Signals China commodity demand recovery and potential inflation shift for Chinese equities and commodity exporters.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Turmoil & Funding Stress
trends.summary: Private credit markets experiencing significant turmoil as rising interest rates and geopolitical risk increase refinancing costs. Mistral securing $830M debt financing signals ongoing funding pressure despite AI sector growth. Capital allocation shifting toward safer credit structures.

trends.name: Sysco $29B Restaurant Depot Acquisition
trends.summary: Sysco nearing $29B buyout of family-owned Restaurant Depot to consolidate 'cash and carry' food-service business. Major consolidation move in food distribution sector amid inflationary cost pressures and margin compression from rising commodity prices.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Quantum Tech Investment Race
trends.summary: Quantum technology firms racing to market as industry sees 'inflection point'; tech companies like Palantir stocking offices with productivity-enhancing tools. Mistral's $830M data center financing reflects AI compute arms race despite macro headwinds.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk Premium: NATO Fracture & Logistics
trends.summary: NATO alliance showing bigger cracks; Spain closing airspace to Iran-related flights forcing US military rerouting through other members. Trump weighing complex uranium extraction mission inside Iran. Escalating logistics complexity and military cost inflation amid alliance tensions.
